name: Lead qualification
tagline: Qualifies inbound leads with a flow, routes them and posts the result to your CRM.
description: Asks a fixed set of qualification questions, extracts the answers as flow variables, routes the lead to a demo or to nurture, and scores the call. The session.ended webhook carries the variables and the disposition to your CRM. Set up for a fictional product, Acme.

nodes.label: Start
nodes.greeting: Hi, thanks for your interest in Acme. I'll ask a few quick questions so the right person can follow up. Sound good?

nodes.label: Global
nodes.instructions: You qualify leads for Acme. One question at a time, acknowledge each answer, never pressure. Use search_knowledge when asked about pricing or features. push_note anything unusual.

nodes.label: Company
nodes.instructions: Ask for the company name and the caller's role.

nodes.label: Needs
nodes.instructions: Ask what they are trying to solve, how many people would use it, and when they want to start.

nodes.label: Budget
nodes.instructions: Ask whether they have a budget range in mind; accept 'not sure'.

nodes.label: Book a demo
nodes.instructions: Offer a demo with a specialist; ask for the best email and a preferred day. Call set_status with qualified.

nodes.label: Qualified
nodes.farewell: Perfect — a specialist will email you within one business day to confirm the demo.

nodes.label: Nurture
nodes.farewell: Thanks — I'll send over some material and we can pick this up when the timing is right.

nodes.label: QA
nodes.rubric_prompt: Score 1–5: were all qualification questions asked, was the routing decision consistent with the answers, was the tone consultative, did the agent avoid pressure.

edges.condition: the company name and role are known
the use case, team size and timeline are known
timeline is within 6 months and team_size is 5 or more
timeline is later than 6 months, or team_size is under 5, or the caller is only researching
the caller declines to answer questions

variables.name: use_case
variables.description: What they are trying to solve

variables.name: team_size
variables.description: How many people would use it

variables.name: email
variables.description: The best email for the follow-up

sample_prompts: We're a 20-person team looking at this for Q4.
